high.affected_gate: candidate dependency closure, BLS validity and arm replay
high.evidence: The scorer hashes and closes runner/base dependencies before reopening them for import. The runner hashes and closes the drand runtime tree before Node imports it. A same-UID replacement can therefore execute bytes different from those checked.
high.reproduction: Replace runner/base or an imported drand module after its hash check but before import/Node execution, then restore it before exit.
high.acceptance_test: Execute retained candidate runner/base bytes and a sealed verified BLS implementation; a deterministic swap between verification and execution must not affect executed bytes or must FAIL.
